pages.text: Every hunt, every fight and every patrol teaches your body. Open your skill tree from your inventory to grow your health, speed, jumping, claws, pelt and stealth. $(br2)What you learn stays with you, even if StarClan calls you home.
pages.title: Your Skills

pages.text: Stealth is the hardest skill to learn. A truly stealthy warrior can slip past enemies like a shadow at moonhigh.
